summary:
## Verdict

**Do not merge** — this change introduces a critical broken-access-control (IDOR) bug on the account lookup path.

## Narrative

`getAccount` previously scoped the query to `caller.accountId` from `auth(req)`, so a caller could only read their own account. The new code prefers `body.accountId` whenever it is present, with **no** check that the caller is support staff (or otherwise authorized to read another account).

Any authenticated user who can hit this route can send `{"accountId": "<victim>"}` and receive that account record. The comment documents staff-tool intent; the code does not enforce it.

## Recommendation

Gate cross-account lookup on an explicit staff/role check (e.g. `caller.isSupport` / equivalent), and keep the default path bound to `caller.accountId`. Reject unauthorized cross-account requests with 403 before querying.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
